summary: Votes: 29 accept, 1 defer (015, kept as a deferred conditional draft), 0 refine, 0 reject; philosophy accept; remaining work accept. All six of my v1 blocking items are resolved in the corrected bytes: 004 benefit moved to the adoption gate; 010 frontend-timer scope; 013 ELM-PER traceability; 020 no-defer clause plus the refresh-churn and Pending races as scenarios; 027 frozen pacing and root-surface-only coverage; 029 restored to its P5 phase. Philosophy now says 'never' replay Unknown. Remaining work now gates S07/S11/RC on the S02 policy freeze and names drag/resize52. I reviewed all 67 scenarios and found no THEN clause unsupported by its EARS and guardrails. Remaining notes are editorial or qualification-time only: P-format priorities for 011-014, a duplicated sentence in 013, 027's cross-reference to draft 026, sampled-versus-presented motion divergence and motion-preference provenance under W12. Each accept is for a guarded draft contract only, with conditional mechanisms not selected. It is not native acceptance, production-provider qualification or baseline expansion; 242/417, the original preview13, restore38/recovery34, drag/resize52, original deadlines, native authority, no Unknown replay and conditional C00-C06 remain intact. I read the consensus change log, candidates-v2 (EARS, priority and status fields plus every changed scenario), PHILOSOPHY-V2, REMAINING-WORK-EARS-V2 and the header of remaining-work-v2.json. I did not independently recompute the SHA256 values; I am ratifying the bytes the coordinator identified by them. These votes are mine alone and say nothing about other reviewers' positions.
